summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the completed acquisition of 100% of Juno Participações e Investimentos S.A. from Triunfo Participações e Investimentos S.A. and Mercúrio Participações e Investimentos S.A. for BRL 256 million (post-adjustments). The target holds 50.1% of Tijo Energia, which controls the Três Irmãos hydroelectric plant (808 MW). The deal was first disclosed on October 29, 2025, and closed after fulfillment of conditions precedent. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. Post-closing, AXIA consolidates 100% of the plant. Watch for integration and potential capacity expansion of the three additional generating units.
